content.intro: Operator Precedence and Associativity is lesson 34 in Operators and Expressions. An operator combines values or expressions according to defined rules. Use parentheses when they make intent easier to see, especially when several operators interact.
content.why_it_matters: Operators are compact expressions of behavior. Understanding evaluation order prevents subtle bugs. This lesson focuses on operator precedence and associativity and shows how to verify the behavior instead of relying on assumptions.
